SELECT user_account.id, employee.id AS employee_id, employee.employee_no, COALESCE(employee.name, user_account.name) AS display_name, user_account.login_act, organization.name AS organization_name, position.name AS position_name, manager_employee.name AS manager_name, CASE WHEN employee.id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE' ELSE employee.employment_status END AS employment_status, user_account.account_status, CASE WHEN user_account.manual_locked = 1 THEN 'MANUAL_LOCKED' WHEN user_account.auto_locked_until IS NOT NULL AND user_account.auto_locked_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'AUTO_LOCKED' ELSE 'UNLOCKED' END AS lock_status, user_account.last_login_time, user_account.account_type, user_account.protected_account FROM t_user user_account LEFT JOIN t_employee employee ON employee.user_id = user_account.id
LEFT JOIN t_organization_unit organization ON organization.id = primary_assignment.organization_unit_id LEFT JOIN t_position position ON position.id = primary_assignment.position_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND (LOWER(user_account.login_act) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(employee.name, user_account.name)) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(employee.employee_no, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%'))
AND primary_assignment.organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId} AND primary_assignment.position_id = #{positionId} AND direct_reporting.manager_employee_id = #{managerEmployeeId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role filtered_user_role INNER JOIN t_role filtered_role ON filtered_role.id = filtered_user_role.role_id AND filtered_role.enabled = 1 WHERE filtered_user_role.user_id = user_account.id AND filtered_user_role.role_id = #{roleId} AND filtered_user_role.active_marker = 1 AND (filtered_user_role.effective_from IS NULL OR filtered_user_role.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (filtered_user_role.effective_to IS NULL OR filtered_user_role.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
AND CASE WHEN employee.id IS NULL THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE' ELSE employee.employment_status END = #{employmentStatus}
AND user_account.account_status = #{accountStatus} AND user_account.manual_locked = 1
AND user_account.manual_locked = 0 AND user_account.auto_locked_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
AND user_account.manual_locked = 0 AND (user_account.auto_locked_until IS NULL OR user_account.auto_locked_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY
COALESCE(employee.name, user_account.name) user_account.login_act employment_status user_account.account_status lock_status user_account.last_login_time employee.employee_no
DESC ASC , user_account.id ASC

mapper.sql: from t_user tu inner join t_user_role tur on tu.id = tur.user_id and tur.active_marker=1 and (tur.effective_from is null or tur.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) and (tur.effective_to is null or tur.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) inner join t_role tr on tur.role_id = tr.id inner join t_employee employee on employee.user_id = tu.id and employee.employment_status = 'ACTIVE' inner join t_employee_assignment assignment on assignment.employee_id = employee.id and assignment.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' and assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' and assignment.active_primary_marker = 1 and assignment.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and (assignment.effective_to is null or assignment.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) inner join t_organization_unit organization_unit on organization_unit.id = assignment.organization_unit_id and organization_unit.enabled = 1 and organization_unit.migration_placeholder = 0 inner join t_position position on position.id = assignment.position_id and position.enabled = 1 and position.code <> 'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' where tr.role = 'admin' and tr.enabled = 1 and tu.account_type = 'HUMAN' and tu.protected_account = 0 and tu.account_status = 'ACTIVE' and tu.account_enabled = 1 and tu.must_change_password = 0 and tu.account_no_locked = 1 and tu.account_no_expired = 1 and (tu.account_expires_at is null or tu.account_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) and tu.credentials_no_expired = 1 and tu.manual_locked = 0 and (tu.auto_locked_until is null or tu.auto_locked_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) and (tu.password_expires_at is null or tu.password_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) and ((employee.phone_verified = 1 and employee.phone is not null and trim(employee.phone) <> '') or (employee.email_verified = 1 and employee.email is not null and trim(employee.email) <> ''))
mapper.select: select count(distinct tu.id)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tu.id) FROM t_user tu INNER JOIN t_user_role tur ON tur.user_id=tu.id AND tur.active_marker=1 AND (tur.effective_from IS NULL OR tur.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tur.effective_to IS NULL OR tur.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN t_role tr ON tr.id=tur.role_id AND tr.role='admin' AND tr.enabled=1 INNER JOIN t_employee employee ON employee.user_id=tu.id AND employee.employment_status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE') INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment assignment ON assignment.employee_id=employee.id AND assignment.assignment_type='PRIMARY' AND assignment.status='ACTIVE' AND assignment.active_primary_marker=1 AND assignment.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN t_organization_unit organization_unit ON organization_unit.id=assignment.organization_unit_id AND organization_unit.enabled=1 AND organization_unit.migration_placeholder=0 INNER JOIN t_position position ON position.id=assignment.position_id AND position.enabled=1 AND position.code<>'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' WHERE tu.account_type='HUMAN' AND tu.protected_account=0 AND tu.account_status IN ('INVITED','ACTIVE') AND tu.account_enabled=1 AND tu.account_no_locked=1 AND tu.account_no_expired=1 AND tu.credentials_no_expired=1 AND tu.manual_locked=0 AND (tu.auto_locked_until IS NULL OR tu.auto_locked_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tu.account_expires_at IS NULL OR tu.account_expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tu.password_expires_at IS NULL OR tu.password_expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((employee.phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee.phone)<>'') OR (employee.email IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee.email)<>'')) AND (tu.must_change_password=1 OR NOT ( (employee.phone_verified=1 AND employee.phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee.phone)<>'') OR (employee.email_verified=1 AND employee.email IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee.email)<>'') ))

SELECT FROM t_user WHERE id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT tu.id FROM t_user tu INNER JOIN t_user_role tur ON tur.user_id=tu.id AND tur.active_marker=1 AND (tur.effective_from IS NULL OR tur.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (tur.effective_to IS NULL OR tur.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN t_role tr ON tr.id=tur.role_id AND tr.role='admin' AND tr.enabled=1 INNER JOIN t_employee employee ON employee.user_id=tu.id AND employee.employment_status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE') INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment assignment ON assignment.employee_id=employee.id AND assignment.assignment_type='PRIMARY' AND assignment.status='ACTIVE' AND assignment.active_primary_marker=1 AND assignment.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN t_organization_unit organization_unit ON organization_unit.id=assignment.organization_unit_id AND organization_unit.enabled=1 AND organization_unit.migration_placeholder=0 INNER JOIN t_position position ON position.id=assignment.position_id AND position.enabled=1 AND position.code<>'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' WHERE tu.account_type='HUMAN' AND tu.protected_account=0 AND tu.account_status IN ('INVITED','ACTIVE') AND ((employee.phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee.phone)<>'') OR (employee.email IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee.email)<>'')) ) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.id) FROM t_user account INNER JOIN t_employee employee ON employee.user_id=account.id AND employee.employment_status='ACTIVE' INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment assignment ON assignment.employee_id=employee.id AND assignment.assignment_type='PRIMARY' AND assignment.status='ACTIVE' AND assignment.active_primary_marker=1 AND assignment.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN t_organization_unit organization ON organization.id=assignment.organization_unit_id AND organization.enabled=1 AND organization.migration_placeholder=0 INNER JOIN t_position position ON position.id=assignment.position_id AND position.enabled=1 AND position.code<>'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' WHERE account.id=#{userId} AND account.account_type='HUMAN' AND account.protected_account=0 AND account.account_status='ACTIVE' AND account.account_enabled=1 AND account.must_change_password=0 AND account.account_no_locked=1 AND account.account_no_expired=1 AND account.credentials_no_expired=1 AND account.manual_locked=0 AND (account.auto_locked_until IS NULL OR account.auto_locked_until<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (account.account_expires_at IS NULL OR account.account_expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (account.password_expires_at IS NULL OR account.password_expires_at>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((employee.phone_verified=1 AND employee.phone IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee.phone)<>'') OR (employee.email_verified=1 AND employee.email IS NOT NULL AND trim(employee.email)<>'')) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_permission permission WHERE permission.code='user:permission' AND permission.enabled=1 AND permission.sensitivity_level='PROTECTED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_permission denied WHERE denied.user_id=account.id AND denied.permission_id=permission.id AND denied.effect='DENY' AND denied.active_marker=1 AND denied.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (denied.effective_to IS NULL OR denied.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_role membership INNER JOIN t_role role_record ON role_record.id=membership.role_id AND role_record.enabled=1 AND role_record.scope_type='GLOBAL' INNER JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id=role_record.id AND role_permission.permission_id=permission.id AND role_permission.data_scope_code='GLOBAL' WHERE membership.user_id=account.id AND membership.active_marker=1 AND (membership.effective_from IS NULL OR membership.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (membership.effective_to IS NULL OR membership.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_permission granted WHERE granted.user_id=account.id AND granted.permission_id=permission.id AND granted.effect='GRANT' AND granted.data_scope_code='GLOBAL' AND granted.active_marker=1 AND granted.effective_from<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (granted.effective_to IS NULL OR granted.effective_to>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ) ) )

mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE user_org_ancestors(id,parent_id) AS ( SELECT organization.id,organization.parent_id FROM t_employee employee INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment assignment ON assignment.employee_id=employee.id AND assignment.assignment_type='PRIMARY' AND assignment.status='ACTIVE' AND assignment.active_primary_marker=1 AND assignment.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) INNER JOIN t_organization_unit organization ON organization.id=assignment.organization_unit_id WHERE employee.user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER} UNION ALL SELECT parent.id,parent.parent_id FROM t_organization_unit parent INNER JOIN user_org_ancestors child ON parent.id=child.parent_id ) select tr.id, tr.role, tr.role_name, tr.enabled from t_role tr inner join t_user_role tur on tr.id = tur.role_id where tur.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=INTEGER} and tur.active_marker=1 and (tur.effective_from is null or tur.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) and (tur.effective_to is null or tur.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) and (tr.scope_type='GLOBAL' or exists ( select 1 from t_role_organization applicable where applicable.role_id=tr.id and applicable.organization_unit_id in (select id from user_org_ancestors) ))
